chunks: Forgiver of the sin, and Acceptor of repentance, Severe of retribution, Lord of grace. There is no god but He. Towards Him is the destination.
ai.seo_question: What are the key divine attributes mentioned in this short Shia supplication?
ai.summary: This dhikr, widely cited in Shia hadith collections such as Al-Kafi, encapsulates the dialectic of divine mercy and justice, emphasizing that God's capacity to forgive is balanced by His severity in retribution. It serves as a comprehensive invocation for believers seeking spiritual purification, reminding them that despite the fear of punishment, the ultimate destination is the boundless grace of the Almighty. The inclusion of 'Al-Masir' (the Return) grounds the supplication in the eschatological reality of accountability.
